{{Quote|She wasn't supposed to be able&mdash;They said it would make a Jedi powerless.''"<br />"''What are you talking about?''"<br />"''The miriskin.|[[Chalco]] and [[Daeshara'cor]]|<ref name="Ruin" />}}
'''Miriskin''' was a piece of cloth that was worn around the neck. It was made from the skin of an [[Ysalamiri/Legends|ysalamir]] and was claimed to be able to stop a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] from using their powers on the being who wore it. The miriskin was, of course, a hoax made to dupe the gullible out of their cash, since only living ysalamiri could push back [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. Many examples of miriskin were not even made from the creatures themselves.<ref name="Ruin" />
